summary: QuantaLedger: implement least-privilege role for EU rollout contractor (residency exception)
description: Set up RBAC role mapping for customer-provided EU-based rollout contractor. Exception scope: access to deployment logs/metadata only; no prompt/response access. Ensure auditing/export is enabled for the exception window.
comments:
[2025-06-01] Rafael Mendes: QuantaLedger asked that their EU subcontractor participate in rollout troubleshooting. Security says ok if least privilege + audited. Creating ticket to track implementation details.

[2025-06-02] Aisha Rahman: Confirm contractor cannot use break-glass. Role must be pre-approved and scoped to operational metadata.

[2025-06-04] Jonas Weber: Implemented role ql-rollout-observer (cluster read-only + selected console views). Verified prompt/response access is not granted.

[2025-06-06] Rafael Mendes: Customer validated access. Closing.
